videoName: Capital Q flagship — Zino Aviation (AI presenter)
tone: Premium, assured, founder-led story told in the third person. Slightly slower on the closing line.
script: Hello. I'm an AI presenter, telling the story of Zino Aviation. Captain Zino Mario, by his own account, flew airplanes and helicopters, including offshore operations, before retiring from active flying to run Zino Aviation full time. From Lagos, Zino Aviation Academy guides aspiring pilots from their first question towards their first job: mentorship, ground school, simulator sessions, and flight training delivered through partner schools in South Africa and Greece. Type ratings and medicals come through partner providers, so each step sits with the right specialist. Alongside the Academy, Zino Aviation Jet is a new advisory and brokerage service for private aviation, taking charter and acquisition enquiries today, with more services on the way. One brand, one point of contact, from the classroom to the cabin. Zino Aviation.
